name: mpg123
input_api: mpg123_open_feed(mh); mpg123_feed(mh, local bytes, size); mpg123_decode_frame() until MPG123_NEED_MORE; mpg123_getformat(); mpg123_info2()
scope: Every MPEG Layer III frame of an untagged stream fed from memory and decoded: sample rate, channels, layer, frame count, decoded samples per channel
family_note: Same libmpg123 engine as the mp3_id3v2/c mpg123 entry and the decoder behind libsndfile, SDL2_mixer and LAME HIP paths there; this record covers plain frame decoding through the feed API, not ID3v2.

name: libmad
input_api: mad_stream_buffer(stream, local bytes followed by MAD_BUFFER_GUARD zero bytes, length); mad_frame_decode() until MAD_ERROR_BUFLEN; mad_synth_frame(); MAD_RECOVERABLE() error classification
documentation_note: libmad has no separate API manual; the public header declares the stream/frame/synth calls, error codes and MAD_BUFFER_GUARD, and examples/minimad.c shows mad_stream_buffer over an in-memory file.
scope: Every MPEG Layer III frame of an untagged stream buffered from memory, decoded and synthesized: sample rate, channels, layer, frame count, decoded samples per channel, bitrate range, recoverable errors, consumed bytes
family_note: Independent fixed-point decoder, not libmpg123. The same libmad engine is linked by the SoX path under mp3_id3v2/c and by libmp3splt and mpg321 leads here.

metric.name: Homebrew install-on-request count (365 days)
metric.note: Aggregate 365-day install-on-request endpoint, window 2025-11-17 to 2026-11-17, rechecked 2026-11-17 at 1,145; the per-formula API splits it into mad 1,141 and mad --HEAD 4. It counts installs of the formula, not programs calling the decoder API.
